lesson: The system consistently attempted to catch long entries into bearish 4h momentum and overextended RSI levels, ignoring clear signs of distribution. These losses highlight a failure to respect the higher timeframe trend and mean-reversion signals during corrective phases.
adjustment: Mandate a 4h EMA alignment filter that prohibits long entries when price is trading below the 4h 50-period EMA, regardless of 1h bullish structure.
methodology_flag: Trust 4h trend structure over 1h bullish micro-patterns for ZECUSDT.
